reviewer_statement: Developer-side semantic source review for functional_simulation_reporting_text based on frozen eyetrajectoriespy 1.2.0 public reporting.py and typed simulation/truth objects, three independent scientific record configurations, full curve-level frame contents, twelve full-string report comparisons over four precision settings, and explicit malformed native record domains. Exact-head CI and external certification are pending. Python dataclass and pandas class identity are not claimed in R.
native_language_semantic_policy: Python dataclasses map to validated native scientific list records, pandas data.frame maps to source-ordered native R data.frame and Python str to native R character scalar. Python repr for supplied provenance labels and source scientific wording is reproduced with no Python called at native runtime.

case_evidence.description: Frozen Python 1.2 typed FunctionalSimulationResult and FunctionalSimulationTruth scientific records vs native R checked source-shaped result.

Three source-shaped cases: participant-grouped dense process, student-t irregular Unicode/apostrophe provenance with large representable seed, and without participant grouping or optional provenance fields.

Three full Python pandas frame shape, column order and all values; twelve exact full-string Python report comparisons over three scientific cases and digits 1,3,6,11, with fixed original truth geometry.
Native R rejects incomplete masks or time lengths, malformed phase grids, nonfinite eigen spectrum/covariance, and invalid report precision; Python exception identity remains language specific.
Source schema includes one pandas-equivalent R data.frame with source ordered columns and numerical scalars, or exact source R string for manuscript reporting (not arbitrary Python objects).

Exact source functional process simulation description including native truth hierarchy, student-t score degrees of freedom, spectral variance significant-digit formatting, missingness, phase, covariance, interpolation and random-state provenance.

independent_review_status: Developer full scientific source-record review only, differential CI and independent certification pending.
